visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Adjacency List Instead of a Full Matrix
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A 5 by 5 matrix stores every possible edge, and every node scans all five columns. Store only each node's neighbours in a small list. The visiting order and output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: For a sparse graph an adjacency list stores and scans only the edges that exist, instead of n squared matrix cells. The loop ends at the -1 marker, and the neighbours are listed in ascending order so the visiting order is unchanged.
